text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Wellesley Street East, City Council approval of this report is required. Aragon Properties Ltd. is constructing a 28-storey residential condominium building at 81 Wellesley Street East. The site is located the south side of Wellesley Street East, between Church Street and Jarvis Street. The sidewalk, bike lane and a portion of the eastbound lane on the south side of Wellesley Street East fronting the site are currently closed to accommodate construction staging operations for the development. City Council, at its meeting on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, approved the subject construction staging area on Wellesley Street East, from May 1, 2018 to May 1, 2019.
